title: Transition-resolved spin-spin relaxation of 209Bi NQR coherences
citation: C. Goesweiner, P.-O. Westlund, and H. Scharfetter, Molecular Physics 118, e1743888 (2020)
transcription: author-supplied table transcribed manually and visually checked against the open-access PDF
observable: R2 from mono-exponential variable-echo-time spin-echo measurements
uncertainty_note: Pointwise uncertainties are discussed in the supplemental material but are not printed in Table 1.

published_models.FVA: fluctuating-EFG model with a vibrational spectral-density mode

published_fva_parameters: The CSV repeats q_cc, tau_c, and nu_v from Table 1 for every transition in each sample/temperature group.
normalization_note: Package validation compares rate shapes after one amplitude scale per group because the Cartesian fluctuating-EFG tensor and the paper's spherical q_cc convention differ by a constant normalization.
model_boundary: The published R2_sim columns are comparison targets, not experimental observations and not package-generated expected values.
